On March 23, 1998 Celine Dion attended to the 70th Annual Academy Awards ceremony, (frequently known as the Oscars), which took place at the Shrine Auditorium in Los Angeles, USA. The 70th Academy Awards were noted for their high ratings and the 11 wins obtained by the Best Picture "Titanic". Billy Crystal hosted the ceremony for the sixth time, and received an Emmy Award for his performance. "Titanic" dominated the evening picking up 11 awards out of 14 nominations. The film tied with the most awards nominated with "All About Eve" and tied with the most awards won with "Ben-Hur". Due to the popularity of "Titanic", which was still the #1 movie at the box office at the time, the show earned its highest ratings ever in history based on audience size (57.25 million). Celine won an Oscar in the category Better Original Song. She performed the winning song "My heart will go on", wearing a dark blue high-neck gown by Michael Kors to bring focus to the Titanic-inspired necklace. Celine's husband, Rene Angelil, was accompanying her. At the end of the ceremony, Celine was photographed with James Horner and Will Jennings. Celine was also photographed with Tommy Mottola. The ceremony was directed by Louis J. Horvitz. After the ceremony, Celine changed her outfit and she was photographed with her husband Rene.
